name: claude-desk-neighbours
description: Five small Claude Code mods that sit under your prompt: remember corrections, flag unanswered questions, catch you up, show your work, and close out PRs.

plugins.name: grudge
plugins.description: 😤 Remembers your corrections: offers to hold a lasting preference, reminds Claude of it every session, and fixes commands it can swap safely.

plugins.name: your-serve
plugins.description: 🎾 Tells you when Claude needs you: one line with the question it ended on, and its answers as buttons.

plugins.name: previously-on
plugins.description: 📺 Catches you up: a recap when you come back to a session, a morning digest of yesterday, and /standup.

plugins.name: show-and-tell
plugins.description: 📸 Shows you the pictures: a thumbnail the moment you paste one, and /gallery of every image you and Claude passed around this session.

plugins.name: closing-time
plugins.description: 🔔 Closes the PR loop: watches a PR until CI and agent reviews are green, and weighs review comments before acting on them.
